description: Envryn's main window. Deliberately minimal: the UI needs no filesystem, shell, HTTP, or clipboard plugin permissions, because every such operation is performed by the Rust core behind a named IPC command. The window-control permissions below are the one addition beyond core:default, needed for the custom frameless title bar (TitleBar.tsx/ResizeBorders.tsx) to drag, resize, minimize, maximize, and close the window itself -- core:default's core:window:default set does not include them.
